title: Kabukibu!: Oogiri - Chiyokoreito Kassen
justification: AniList 98851 (SPECIAL, 1 episode(s) from 2017-09-27) is AniDB 12329's special(s) S2, aired 2017-09-27. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 87500, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 12329, and the special's title (Epilogue: Chocolate Wars / Chiyoko Rei to Gassen) matches an AniList title. The parent's node, as overlay/12329.json patches it, places S2 on TVDB 0x1 Epilogue - Chocolate Wars, 2017-09-27. TMDB 71009, where the parent's node places the special(s) through the overlay's TMDB row, agrees: S0E1 Epilogue: Chocolate Wars 2017-09-27.
